Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the demo last week — Bluefin is excited to move forward. Finance asked me to gather the vendor setup info so we can issue POs and set up ACH payments. Attached is our standard supplier intake checklist (I also attached our W9). Can you confirm the fields below and return any missing items?

- Legal entity name used for tax purposes
- Remit-to address and preferred payment method (ACH preferred)
- Tax ID / EIN or W-9 (I attached)
- Primary billing contact (name, email, phone)
- Any purchase order requirements (PO reference, invoice email)

- Legal entity: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (our payment/legal name).

- Tax ID/EIN: on our attached W9 (let us know if you need the scanned signature).
- Preferred payment method: ACH is preferred; Dev will share bank routing details directly to AP when ready.
- PO process: our standard is PO number on invoice; net 30 unless otherwise agreed. We can accept invoice via email or via vendor portal if you use one.

I've attached: vendor_intake_form.xlsx_stub (fillable), redwood_w9.pdf_stub (signed). Please return the intake form and indicate the preferred PO/invoice path.

2) Dev creates vendor record and shares ACH instructions to Bluefin AP (secure channel)
3) Lauren confirms any PO template or special references we should use
4) Neha reviews any MSLA/contract if you intend to sign a vendor agreement before first invoice

Ping me if you want a quick 15-min Handoff call to walk finance through fields.
